# Any Things Solution (ATS)

> Tech agency. We solve business problems with technology — digital products, software, apps, and AI that help companies grow and shift.

Any Things Solution is not a marketing shop. Bring the problem. We pick the technology and build the path: product, platform, app, or system. Designers, developers, and strategists work as one team.

## Products built by ATS

### Krishi Udhar (कृषि उधार)

Krishi Udhar is billing and farmer-credit (udhari) software for small fertiliser, seed and agri-input shops in India. Anythingssolution (ATS) designed, built and operates it.

- Live product: https://krishiudhar.com
- ATS case study: https://anythingssolution.com/work/krishi-udhar
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@krishiudhar
- Product help: krishiudhar@gmail.com

Shopkeepers print Hindi bills, keep each farmer’s khata, track stock (batch / expiry), dealer purchases and goods returns, and send a manual WhatsApp due reminder. Currently free during beta; future pricing is not announced. It is shop accounting — not GST filing, not automatic messaging, not a loan product.
